title: Show a display name
prompt: `DisplayName(string? nickname)` should return `"Guest"` when nickname is null, and the nickname itself otherwise. An empty string is a real nickname here, so it is returned as it is. The starter gets both the missing case and the empty case wrong.
hints: What does nickname.Length do when nickname is null?
Only null means missing. An empty string must come back unchanged.
checkLabels: A named nickname must be returned unchanged.
An empty nickname name must be returned as it is.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty string as a missing nickname.
Replaces a missing nickname with empty text instead of the label.

feedback: Check the three inputs separately: null, an empty string, and a name. Only null gets the label.
